description: This PHP source file defines the RoutingMiddleware class for the Slim Framework. It handles routing logic for HTTP requests, resolving routes and managing routing results, exceptions, and request attributes.

classes.name: RoutingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that performs request routing by resolving route information from the request and attaching relevant attributes. Handles route not found and method not allowed exceptions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the route resolver and parser dependencies.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method to process the incoming request, performing routing and passing control to the handler.

methods.name: performRouting
methods.description: Performs the routing logic, resolving the route and handling different routing outcomes (found, not found, method not allowed).

methods.name: resolveRoutingResultsFromRequest
methods.description: Resolves routing results based on the request URI path and method.
